words.enDefinition: A passenger train linking separate cities, often over substantial distances

examples.en: I took an intercity train to see my friends after exams.
examples.zh: 考完试后，我坐「城际列车」去看朋友。

examples.en: The intercity train left from a different station than the commuter trains.
examples.zh: 「城际列车」和通勤列车不在同一个车站发车。

words.enDefinition: A bus designed to carry passengers between relatively distant places

examples.en: My flatmate took a long-distance coach home during the reading week.
examples.zh: 我室友在复习周坐「长途大巴」回了家。

examples.en: We boarded the long-distance coach outside the main station after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我们在主车站外面上了「长途大巴」。

words.enDefinition: A long-distance bus making fewer stops than other services

examples.en: We chose the express coach because it stopped in fewer towns.
examples.zh: 我们选了「少停站的快速大巴」，因为沿途停靠的城镇更少。

examples.en: The express coach shown on the timetable left just after our seminar.
examples.zh: 时刻表上的「少停站的快速大巴」在研讨课结束后不久发车。

words.enDefinition: A passenger train connecting places within a particular region

examples.en: We took a regional train to a town down the coast.
examples.zh: 我们坐「区域列车」去了沿海的一个小镇。

examples.en: The regional train stopped in the town where my friend lives.
examples.zh: 「区域列车」在我朋友住的那个小镇停靠。

words.enDefinition: A passenger train that runs during the night

examples.en: I booked a night train so I could travel after class.
examples.zh: 我订了「夜间列车」，这样下课之后还能出发。

examples.en: The night train reached the city just before my friends woke up.
examples.zh: 朋友们快起床时，「夜间列车」到了那座城市。

words.enDefinition: A train with beds or berths for passengers to sleep in

examples.en: My friend booked a sleeper train for the trip between the cities.
examples.zh: 朋友订了两座城市之间的「卧铺列车」。

examples.en: I asked where the sleeper train would be waiting that evening.
examples.zh: 我问那天晚上「卧铺列车」会停在哪里。

words.enDefinition: The amount charged for a journey by passenger train

examples.en: We compared the rail fare with the cost of taking the coach.
examples.zh: 我们把「铁路票价」和坐长途大巴的费用作了比较。

examples.en: The operator displayed each rail fare beside the departure time.
examples.zh: 运营方在出发时间旁标出了每趟车的「铁路票价」。

words.enDefinition: The price charged for a journey on a long-distance bus

examples.en: I checked the coach fare before suggesting the trip to my flatmates.
examples.zh: 我先看了「长途大巴票价」，才跟室友们提议去旅行。

examples.en: The screen showed the coach fare beside the departure time.
examples.zh: 屏幕在发车时间旁显示了「长途大巴票价」。

words.enDefinition: Arranging a travel reservation before the intended day or time

examples.en: I made an advance booking for the coach after my exam timetable arrived.
examples.zh: 考试时间表下来后，我给长途大巴「提前订票」。

examples.en: The rail website explained where to find my advance booking.
examples.zh: 铁路网站说明了在哪儿可以找到我「提前订票」的记录。

collocations: an advance booking for a train

words.enDefinition: A British rail ticket bought in advance for a specified service

examples.en: I checked which train was printed on my Advance ticket.
examples.zh: 我核对了「英国指定班次预售票」上写的是哪趟列车。

examples.en: The rail website listed an Advance ticket beside the flexible fare.
examples.zh: 铁路网站在灵活票价旁列出了「英国指定班次预售票」。

collocations: an Advance ticket for a specific train
check the details on an Advance ticket

words.enDefinition: A British rail fare without peak-time restrictions on valid travel

examples.en: I asked which route was shown on the Anytime ticket.
examples.zh: 我问「英国不限时段车票」上写的是哪条线路。

examples.en: The British rail website explained what an Anytime ticket covered.
examples.zh: 英国铁路网站解释了「英国不限时段车票」涵盖哪些行程。

collocations: check the route on an Anytime ticket

words.enDefinition: A British rail fare for travel at specified quieter times

examples.en: I asked where to read the timing restrictions on my Off-Peak ticket.
examples.zh: 我问在哪里可以查看「英国非高峰票」的时段限制。

examples.en: The British rail website displayed an Off-Peak ticket for our planned journey.
examples.zh: 英国铁路网站显示，我们计划的行程有「英国非高峰票」。

collocations: an Off-Peak ticket for the return journey

words.zhGloss: 不指定返程班次的往返票
words.enDefinition: A return fare that leaves the exact return service unspecified
acceptedZhAnswers: 不指定返程班次的往返票

examples.en: I chose an open return because I hadn't decided when to leave.
examples.zh: 我还没决定哪趟车回来，所以买了「不指定返程班次的往返票」。

examples.en: The agent pointed out the dates printed on my open return.
examples.zh: 售票员指出了「不指定返程班次的往返票」上印的日期。

collocations: check the dates on an open return

words.enDefinition: A fare that covers both parts of a return journey on one day

examples.en: We bought a day return for our trip to the museum.
examples.zh: 我们为去博物馆的行程买了「当天往返票」。

examples.en: I checked whether the day return showed the correct date for Saturday.
examples.zh: 我核对了「当天往返票」上的日期是不是那个星期六。

collocations: a day return to the city
check the date on a day return

words.enDefinition: The first part of a trip from home to a destination

examples.en: I booked the outward journey after confirming the time of my lecture.
examples.zh: 确认上课时间后，我订了「去程」。

examples.en: The email listed the outward journey before the return details.
examples.zh: 邮件先列出「去程」，然后才是返程详情。

words.enDefinition: The part of a trip that brings someone back

examples.en: The return leg started at a different station from our outward trip.
examples.zh: 「返程段」和我们去时的出发车站不同。

examples.en: I asked which coach was listed for the return leg of our trip.
examples.zh: 我问我们的「返程段」写的是哪趟大巴。

collocations: the return leg of a journey

words.enDefinition: Separate tickets used for different portions of one rail journey

examples.en: The rail website labeled that option as split tickets for the journey.
examples.zh: 铁路网站把这趟行程的那个选项标为「分段购买的铁路票」。

examples.en: I asked the agent why the email showed two split tickets.
examples.zh: 我问售票员，为什么邮件里有两张「分段购买的铁路票」。

words.enDefinition: One ticket covering a journey that may involve several services

examples.en: I asked whether one through ticket could cover both train services.
examples.zh: 我问一张「全程联票」能不能覆盖两趟列车。

examples.en: The through ticket showed each part of the trip on a separate line.
examples.zh: 「全程联票」每一行分别列了一段行程。

words.enDefinition: A British card linked to discounts on certain railway fares

examples.en: The clerk asked whether my booking included a railcard discount.
examples.zh: 售票员问我的订单有没有使用「英国铁路折扣卡」优惠。

examples.en: I checked the name on my ticket against my railcard.
examples.zh: 我核对了车票姓名是否和「英国铁路折扣卡」上的一致。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement holding a place on a particular departure for someone

examples.en: The email had my ticket and a separate seat reservation for the train.
examples.zh: 邮件里有车票，还有单独的一份列车「座位预订」。

examples.en: I checked the seat reservation before choosing where to wait on the platform.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「座位预订」，再决定在站台哪个位置候车。

words.enDefinition: The process of choosing where to sit when booking travel

examples.en: The seat selection screen showed which seats faced the front of the train.
examples.zh: 「座位选择」页面显示了哪些座位面朝列车前方。

examples.en: I asked whether seat selection was available for the long coach journey.
examples.zh: 我问这趟长途大巴是否提供「座位选择」。

collocations: choose from the seat selection screen

words.enDefinition: A diagram showing the location of seats within a vehicle

examples.en: I opened the seat map to find a seat beside my friend.
examples.zh: 我打开「座位示意图」，找朋友旁边的座位。

examples.en: The seat map showed the table seats at one end of the carriage.
examples.zh: 「座位示意图」显示，带桌座位在车厢的一端。

collocations: choose a seat from the seat map

words.enDefinition: A particular place held for a passenger on a service

examples.en: I found my reserved seat by checking the number above the window.
examples.zh: 我看了窗户上方的编号，找到了「已预订座位」。

examples.en: The clerk asked whether the ticket showed my reserved seat.
examples.zh: 售票员问车票上是否显示了我的「已预订座位」。

words.enDefinition: Seating available without assigned places for the passengers using it

examples.en: The conductor explained that the rear carriage had unreserved seating.
examples.zh: 列车员说明后面的车厢是「不对号入座」。

examples.en: I checked whether our coach ticket said we had unreserved seating.
examples.zh: 我看了下我们的长途大巴票，上面有没有写「不对号入座」。

words.enDefinition: A train departure for which no additional reservations are available

examples.en: The ticket office showed a fully booked train on our original route.
examples.zh: 售票处显示，我们原来选的线路上有一趟「座位订满的列车」。

examples.en: We chose another departure after seeing a fully booked train on the screen.
examples.zh: 屏幕上看到那趟「座位订满的列车」后，我们选了另一个班次。

collocations: check for a fully booked train
a notice for a fully booked train

words.enDefinition: A booking code used to identify tickets when collecting them

examples.en: I found the ticket collection reference near the bottom of the email.
examples.zh: 我在邮件靠近末尾的地方找到了「取票编号」。

examples.en: The clerk pointed out where the ticket collection reference appeared on my confirmation.
examples.zh: 售票员指出了我的确认信息里「取票编号」的位置。

words.enDefinition: To pick up tickets that have already been booked

examples.en: The confirmation tells you where to collect your tickets at the station.
examples.zh: 确认信息会告诉你在车站哪里「领取车票」。

examples.en: My friend asked how to collect your tickets when the machine was closed.
examples.zh: 朋友问机器停用时怎样「领取车票」。

collocations: collect your tickets at the station
collect your tickets from a machine

words.enDefinition: A travel document provided electronically for someone to print themselves

examples.en: I found the print-at-home ticket attached to the email from the operator.
examples.zh: 我在运营方发来的邮件附件中找到了「自行打印的车票」。

examples.en: My flatmate looked for the print-at-home ticket before we went to the station.
examples.zh: 我们去车站前，室友找了一下「自行打印的车票」。

words.enDefinition: Conditions limiting when or how a travel ticket may be used

examples.en: I asked the agent which ticket restrictions applied to my departure.
examples.zh: 我问售票员，哪些「车票使用限制」适用于我选的班次。

examples.en: The booking displayed the ticket restrictions on a separate page.
examples.zh: 订票系统在单独一页上列出了「车票使用限制」。

words.enDefinition: A fare allowing changes to a booking under its terms

examples.en: I checked what the coach website meant by a changeable fare.
examples.zh: 我看了看长途大巴网站上说的「可改签票价」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clerk explained which conditions came with the changeable fare.
examples.zh: 售票员解释了「可改签票价」附带哪些条件。

words.enDefinition: A stop made partway through a rail journey before continuing later

examples.en: I asked the rail agent what break of journey meant for that route.
examples.zh: 我问铁路售票员，在那条线路上「中途下车后续乘」指什么。

examples.en: The example showed a break of journey in the town where we changed trains.
examples.zh: 示例展示了可以在换乘的小镇「中途下车后续乘」。

words.enDefinition: A number identifying a particular scheduled passenger train service

examples.en: I checked the train number rather than the time on the display.
examples.zh: 我核对的是「列车车次」，没看显示屏上的时间。

examples.en: The train number on the announcement matched the one in my booking.
examples.zh: 广播报出的「列车车次」和我的订单一致。

words.enDefinition: A number identifying a particular passenger carriage on a train

examples.en: I checked the coach number on the side of the train.
examples.zh: 我核对了车身上的「列车车厢编号」。

examples.en: The ticket displayed my seat beside the coach number for that carriage.
examples.zh: 车票上的「列车车厢编号」旁写了我的座位。

collocations: the coach number on your ticket

words.enDefinition: A sign showing where a numbered train carriage is expected to stop

examples.en: I waited by the carriage marker after checking which coach I needed.
examples.zh: 核对我要坐哪节车厢后，我在「车厢候车位置标识」旁等车。

examples.en: The carriage marker was painted on the ground near the stairs.
examples.zh: 「车厢候车位置标识」涂在楼梯附近的地面上。

words.enDefinition: The arrangement and order of carriages forming a train service

examples.en: The train formation diagram showed which end had the quiet carriage.
examples.zh: 「列车编组」示意图显示安静车厢在哪一端。

examples.en: The board showed a different train formation from the previous service.
examples.zh: 显示屏上的「列车编组」和上一班列车的不同。

words.enDefinition: A passenger seat located immediately next to the aisle

examples.en: My friend chose an aisle seat on the train to the coast.
examples.zh: 朋友在去海边的列车上选了「靠过道的座位」。

examples.en: One aisle seat was available in the same carriage as mine.
examples.zh: 和我同一车厢里，还有一个「靠过道的座位」空着。

words.enDefinition: A place with its occupant facing the direction of travel

examples.en: The seat map showed only one forward-facing seat near a window.
examples.zh: 座位图上只有一个靠窗且「顺向座位」。

examples.en: I asked whether my ticket showed a forward-facing seat on this train.
examples.zh: 我问车票是否显示我坐的是这趟车上「顺向座位」。

words.enDefinition: A place with its occupant facing away from the direction of travel

examples.en: The only place near my friend was a rear-facing seat.
examples.zh: 朋友附近唯一的空位是一个「逆向座位」。

examples.en: I spotted a rear-facing seat beside the table on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我在示意图上看到桌旁有一个「逆向座位」。

words.enDefinition: A train seat arranged next to a table shared by passengers

examples.en: I chose a table seat so I could review my notes.
examples.zh: 我选了一个「带桌座位」，这样可以复习笔记。

examples.en: The seat map marked each table seat with a small rectangle.
examples.zh: 座位图用小长方形标出了每个「带桌座位」。

collocations: a table seat with space for a laptop

words.enDefinition: A seat with a back that can tilt backward

examples.en: The coach ticket listed a reclining seat among the available features.
examples.zh: 长途大巴车票上列出的设施包括「可调靠背座椅」。

examples.en: My flatmate chose a reclining seat near the front of the coach.
examples.zh: 室友选了大巴靠前位置的「可调靠背座椅」。

collocations: a reclining seat on a coach

words.enDefinition: A train carriage designated for passengers to keep noise low

examples.en: I checked the map to find the quiet carriage before boarding.
examples.zh: 上车前，我看了下图，找到「安静车厢」的位置。

examples.en: The quiet carriage was at the rear of the train today.
examples.zh: 今天「安静车厢」在列车尾部。

collocations: a seat in the quiet carriage

words.enDefinition: An ordinary rail travel class below a higher service tier

examples.en: I checked which carriages were marked standard class before boarding.
examples.zh: 上车前，我核对了哪些车厢标为「标准席」。

examples.en: The UK rail screen showed standard class beside the other class.
examples.zh: 英国的铁路购票屏上把「标准席」和另一等级并排列出。

words.enDefinition: Amtrak's regular seated travel class on many passenger train services

examples.en: The Amtrak app listed Coach Class for our overnight trip.
examples.zh: Amtrak 应用显示，我们的夜间行程有「美式列车普通座席」可选。

examples.en: My friend checked whether Coach Class was available on that departure.
examples.zh: 朋友核对了那趟车有没有「美式列车普通座席」。

words.enDefinition: An individual sleeping place in a train carriage

examples.en: I checked whether the sleeper berth was printed on my booking.
examples.zh: 我核对了我的订单上有没有写「列车卧铺铺位」。

examples.en: My flatmate booked a sleeper berth for the journey through the night.
examples.zh: 室友为夜间行程订了一个「列车卧铺铺位」。

collocations: a sleeper berth on a night train

words.enDefinition: A sleeping place positioned above another in a train compartment

examples.en: I found my name next to the upper berth in the compartment.
examples.zh: 我在包厢里看到「上铺」旁边写着我的名字。

examples.en: The conductor showed which number belonged to the upper berth on my ticket.
examples.zh: 列车员指出车票上的哪个号码对应「上铺」。

words.enDefinition: A sleeping place positioned below another in a train compartment

examples.en: I requested a lower berth when booking the overnight train.
examples.zh: 我订夜间列车时选了「下铺」。

examples.en: My roommate had the lower berth in the same compartment as me.
examples.zh: 我室友坐的是跟我同一个包厢的「下铺」。

words.enDefinition: An enclosed part of a train fitted with sleeping places

examples.en: I asked where our sleeper compartment was when the train arrived.
examples.zh: 列车进站时，我问了我们的「卧铺包厢」在哪里。

examples.en: The booking showed which carriage contained the sleeper compartment for our group.
examples.zh: 订单上标明我们一行人的「卧铺包厢」在哪节车厢。

words.enDefinition: A small private sleeping compartment on certain American trains

examples.en: The Amtrak booking page showed a roomette beside the seating options.
examples.zh: Amtrak 的订票页在座席选项旁列了「小型卧铺包间」。

examples.en: I asked how much space the roomette had for our bags.
examples.zh: 我问「小型卧铺包间」能放下多少行李。

words.enDefinition: A train carriage where passengers can sit and eat meals

examples.en: My friend asked which end of the train had the dining car.
examples.zh: 朋友问列车哪一端有「餐车」。

examples.en: The dining car had tables on both sides of the aisle.
examples.zh: 「餐车」的过道两边都有餐桌。

words.enDefinition: A train carriage selling drinks and snacks to passengers onboard

examples.en: The conductor said the café car was two carriages ahead of ours.
examples.zh: 列车员说，「列车轻食车厢」在我们前面两节车厢。

examples.en: I picked up tea from the café car before returning to my seat.
examples.zh: 我在「列车轻食车厢」买了茶，然后回到了座位上。

collocations: buy coffee in the café car

words.enDefinition: A shelf above passenger seats for storing small bags

examples.en: I found space on the overhead luggage rack for my small bag.
examples.zh: 我在「头顶行李架」上找到了能放小包的地方。

examples.en: The overhead luggage rack was already full when we boarded the train.
examples.zh: 我们上火车时，「头顶行李架」已经放满了。

collocations: put a bag on the overhead luggage rack
room in the overhead luggage rack

words.enDefinition: A set of shelves for larger bags on a train

examples.en: I saw a luggage stack beside the door at the carriage entrance.
examples.zh: 我在车厢入口门边看到了「多层行李架」。

examples.en: The conductor pointed out the luggage stack for larger bags.
examples.zh: 列车员指明了用来放大件行李的「多层行李架」。

collocations: a luggage stack near the door

words.enDefinition: A lower storage compartment for bags in a coach

examples.en: The driver opened the luggage hold before we showed our tickets.
examples.zh: 我们出示车票前，司机打开了「大巴行李舱」。

examples.en: My roommate collected her bag from the luggage hold at our stop.
examples.zh: 到我们下车的站时，室友从「大巴行李舱」里取了她的包。

collocations: put bags in the luggage hold
collect bags from the luggage hold

words.enDefinition: A train carriage used to transport passengers' registered luggage

examples.en: The staff member showed where the train's baggage car was located.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我们看列车的「行李车厢」在什么位置。

examples.en: I asked whether this particular departure had a baggage car that day.
examples.zh: 我问当天这趟车有没有「行李车厢」。

collocations: send a bag in the baggage car

words.enDefinition: Bags or items larger than the operator's ordinary luggage limits

examples.en: My friend asked whether her instrument case counted as oversized luggage.
examples.zh: 朋友问她的乐器盒算不算「超尺寸行李」。

examples.en: The coach operator listed oversized luggage separately in its luggage guide.
examples.zh: 长途大巴运营方在行李指南里单独列出了「超尺寸行李」。

words.enDefinition: The quantity or size of baggage permitted for a booking

examples.en: I checked the luggage allowance before choosing a bag for the coach.
examples.zh: 我先看了「行李限额」，再选坐大巴时带的包。

examples.en: The operator explained where the luggage allowance appeared on my booking.
examples.zh: 运营方说明了我的订单上在哪里显示「行李限额」。

words.enDefinition: A lockable compartment where travelers can temporarily leave bags

examples.en: I found a luggage locker beside the stairs at the station.
examples.zh: 我在车站楼梯旁找到了一个「行李寄存柜」。

examples.en: We looked for a luggage locker large enough for two bags.
examples.zh: 我们找了一个能放下两个包的「行李寄存柜」。

words.enDefinition: A staffed place where passengers can leave luggage temporarily

examples.en: We passed the left-luggage office on our way to the station exit.
examples.zh: 我们去车站出口时经过了「行李寄存处」。

examples.en: I checked when the left-luggage office would close before leaving my bag.
examples.zh: 寄存包之前，我先查了「行李寄存处」几点关门。

collocations: leave a bag at the left-luggage office

words.enDefinition: An arrangement reserving space for a bicycle on a particular train

examples.en: My friend checked whether the email included her bike reservation for the train.
examples.zh: 朋友核对了邮件里是否包含她这趟火车的「自行车上车位预订」。

examples.en: The ticket office told me where my bike reservation was listed.
examples.zh: 售票处告诉我，「自行车上车位预订」记录在哪个位置。

words.enDefinition: A terminal where intercity buses pick up and drop passengers

examples.en: We walked to the coach station together after our last lecture.
examples.zh: 最后一节课结束后，我们一起走去「长途大巴站」。

examples.en: I asked where to find the entrance to the coach station.
examples.zh: 我问「长途大巴站」的入口在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: A room at a station where passengers can wait for services

examples.en: We waited in the station waiting room because it was cold outside.
examples.zh: 外面很冷，我们就在「车站候车室」里等车。

examples.en: The station waiting room had a screen showing the next few departures.
examples.zh: 「车站候车室」里有块屏幕，显示接下来几趟车的发车信息。

collocations: sit in the station waiting room

words.enDefinition: A staffed station desk answering questions about passenger train services

examples.en: I asked at the rail information desk which train had room for bicycles.
examples.zh: 我在「铁路问讯台」问哪趟列车有地方放自行车。

examples.en: The rail information desk was next to the main doors of the station.
examples.zh: 「铁路问讯台」就在车站正门旁边。

collocations: ask at the rail information desk
directions from the rail information desk

words.enDefinition: A station area containing ticket counters or machines

examples.en: We met in the ticket hall before heading to the platform.
examples.zh: 去站台之前，我们在「车站售票厅」碰了面。

examples.en: The exit from the ticket hall was beside the information screen.
examples.zh: 「车站售票厅」的出口在信息显示屏旁边。

collocations: a machine in the ticket hall

words.enDefinition: A place where a worker helps passengers buy travel tickets

examples.en: I looked for a staffed ticket counter because I had a question.
examples.zh: 我有个问题要问，就找了「人工售票窗口」。

examples.en: The staffed ticket counter was still open after my afternoon class ended.
examples.zh: 下午下课后，「人工售票窗口」还开着。

collocations: ask at a staffed ticket counter
buy from a staffed ticket counter

words.enDefinition: A display listing upcoming services, times, and departure locations

examples.en: The departure board showed our train at the top of the list.
examples.zh: 「发车信息屏」把我们的列车列在最上面。

examples.en: We watched the departure board until our platform number appeared there.
examples.zh: 我们一直看着「发车信息屏」，直到上面显示我们的站台号。

words.enDefinition: A display showing incoming services and when they are expected

examples.en: I checked the arrivals board before going to meet my roommate.
examples.zh: 我先看了「到站信息屏」，才去接室友。

examples.en: The arrivals board listed the arrivals from both routes separately.
examples.zh: 「到站信息屏」分开列出了两条线路的抵达班次。

collocations: the arrivals board at the station

words.enDefinition: A number identifying the station platform assigned to a service

examples.en: The platform number appeared on our screen while we were buying coffee.
examples.zh: 我们买咖啡时，屏幕上显示了「站台编号」。

examples.en: I repeated the platform number to my friend over the phone.
examples.zh: 我在电话里把「站台编号」又跟朋友说了一遍。

words.enDefinition: An update assigning a train to a platform different from the previous one

examples.en: The board showed a platform change just as we reached the stairs.
examples.zh: 我们刚到楼梯边，显示屏就显示了「站台变更」。

examples.en: I told my roommate about the platform change before she left the café.
examples.zh: 室友离开咖啡馆前，我把「站台变更」的消息告诉了她。

collocations: a notice about a platform change

words.enDefinition: A marked area where a coach stops to collect passengers

examples.en: I waited at the departure bay printed on my coach ticket.
examples.zh: 我在长途大巴票上印的「大巴发车位」等车。

examples.en: The board showed which departure bay was assigned to our service.
examples.zh: 显示屏标明我们的班次用哪个「大巴发车位」。

collocations: the departure bay for a coach

words.enDefinition: One of the far ends of a railway platform

examples.en: We walked toward the platform end before the train pulled in.
examples.zh: 列车进站前，我们走向了「站台端头」。

examples.en: The platform end nearest our carriage had a long row of seats.
examples.zh: 离我们车厢最近的「站台端头」有一长排座位。

collocations: a sign at the platform end

words.enDefinition: A message telling passengers when or where they may board

examples.en: We heard the boarding announcement from the café beside the platforms.
examples.zh: 我们在站台旁的咖啡馆里听到了「上车广播」。

examples.en: The boarding announcement mentioned which coach was ready for passengers.
examples.zh: 「上车广播」说了哪辆长途大巴已经可以上客。

words.enDefinition: The specific spot where passengers are expected to enter a service

examples.en: The coach's boarding point was beside the station rather than inside it.
examples.zh: 这趟长途大巴的「上车地点」在车站旁，不在里面。

examples.en: I asked whether the boarding point was the same after the change.
examples.zh: 我问变更之后的「上车地点」是不是还在原处。

words.enDefinition: A railway employee overseeing passengers and duties aboard a train

examples.en: The train conductor explained which carriage had space for my bag.
examples.zh: 「列车长」说明了哪节车厢有地方放我的包。

examples.en: I asked the train conductor where to get off for the museum.
examples.zh: 我问「列车长」，去博物馆该在哪站下车。

collocations: a message from the train conductor

words.enDefinition: To present your travel ticket when a transport worker asks

examples.en: The notice asks you to show your ticket at the coach door.
examples.zh: 告示要求在长途大巴车门处「出示车票」。

examples.en: The driver asked passengers to show your ticket before taking their seats.
examples.zh: 长途大巴司机请乘客先「出示车票」，然后再就座。

collocations: show your ticket to the conductor

words.enDefinition: A door allowing entry to or exit from a train carriage

examples.en: I waited near the carriage door with my small suitcase.
examples.zh: 我带着小行李箱，在「车厢门」附近等候。

examples.en: The carriage door was opposite the sign showing our coach number.
examples.zh: 「车厢门」正对着标有我们车厢编号的牌子。

collocations: stand clear of the carriage door

words.enDefinition: To enter a vehicle when it is ready for passengers

examples.en: We waited for the driver to say we could step on board.
examples.zh: 我们等司机告诉我们可以「登车」。

examples.en: My friend checked the train number before she went to step on board.
examples.zh: 朋友先核对了车次号，然后才「登车」。

collocations: invite passengers to step on board
get ready to step on board

words.enDefinition: A train that reaches your destination without requiring a change

examples.en: I chose a direct train because I was carrying several bags.
examples.zh: 因为带了好几个包，我选了「直达列车」。

examples.en: The ticket office showed only one direct train that Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 售票处显示，那个星期六早上只有一趟「直达列车」。

words.enDefinition: A service making no scheduled stops between two locations

examples.en: We chose a nonstop service for the journey between the two cities.
examples.zh: 我们去另一座城市时，选了「中途不停的班次」。

examples.en: The midday coach was a nonstop service on the timetable.
examples.zh: 时刻表上，中午那趟长途大巴是一个「中途不停的班次」。

collocations: a nonstop service to the city

words.enDefinition: A train that calls at many stations along its route

examples.en: We switched to a stopping train that stopped near our destination.
examples.zh: 我们改乘了在目的地附近停靠的「沿途多停的列车」。

examples.en: The stopping train made a short stop at my friend's station.
examples.zh: 「沿途多停的列车」在我朋友所在的车站停了一会儿。

words.enDefinition: A later train used to continue a trip after another service

examples.en: The connecting train left from the other side of the platform.
examples.zh: 「接续列车」从站台另一侧出发。

examples.en: I checked the number of our connecting train before getting off.
examples.zh: 下车之前，我核对了「接续列车」的车次号。

collocations: a ticket for a connecting train

words.enDefinition: A coach used to continue a trip after an earlier service

examples.en: The connecting coach left from a bay behind the train station.
examples.zh: 「接续长途大巴」从火车站后面的一个车位出发。

examples.en: I asked where we would board our connecting coach that evening.
examples.zh: 我问当天晚上在哪里上我们的「接续长途大巴」。

words.enDefinition: To leave one train and board another during a journey

examples.en: We needed to change trains before reaching the town on the coast.
examples.zh: 我们得「换乘火车」，才能到海边的那个小镇。

examples.en: I checked which station we had to change trains at on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我查了星期天得在哪个车站「换乘火车」。

words.enDefinition: To schedule enough time to reach and board a later service

examples.en: The guide reminded us to allow time for the connection at the larger station.
examples.zh: 指南提醒我们，在较大的车站要「给换乘留出时间」。

examples.en: I checked the walking distance to allow time for the connection at the next station.
examples.zh: 我核对了下一站的步行距离，好「给换乘留出时间」。

collocations: allow time for the connection at the station
allow time for the connection between trains
remember to allow time for the connection

words.enDefinition: The next part of a trip after arriving somewhere

examples.en: I arranged onward travel after the train arrival time changed.
examples.zh: 列车的到站时间变了之后，我安排了「后续行程」。

examples.en: The notice gave a separate phone number for onward travel questions.
examples.zh: 通知为咨询「后续行程」单独列了一个电话号码。

words.enDefinition: Delaying a connecting service so arriving passengers can still board

examples.en: The conductor spoke to the other station about holding the connection for us.
examples.zh: 列车长和另一个车站沟通，想为我们「让接续班次等候」。

examples.en: We heard staff discussing holding the connection before the train pulled in.
examples.zh: 列车进站前，我们听到工作人员讨论要不要「让接续班次等候」。

collocations: a notice about holding the connection

words.enDefinition: A short pause in a journey for passengers to use facilities

examples.en: The coach driver announced a comfort break at the next stop.
examples.zh: 长途大巴司机说，下一站会「途中短暂休息」。

examples.en: I asked how long the comfort break would be at the service area.
examples.zh: 我问在服务区「途中短暂休息」会有多长时间。

words.enDefinition: The person responsible for driving a bus on a long route

examples.en: I asked the coach driver where to put my small case.
examples.zh: 我问「长途大巴司机」小箱子该放在哪儿。

examples.en: The coach driver checked our tickets before calling the next group.
examples.zh: 「长途大巴司机」查过我们的车票后，叫了下一组乘客。

collocations: a notice from the coach driver

words.enDefinition: A sign reminding passengers about seat belts inside a vehicle

examples.en: I saw a seat belt sign near the door of the coach.
examples.zh: 我在长途大巴车门旁看到了「安全带提示牌」。

examples.en: The seat belt sign was printed on a card above our seats.
examples.zh: 「安全带提示牌」印在我们座位上方的一张卡片上。

collocations: a seat belt sign above a seat

words.enDefinition: A wheeled cart selling drinks and light food to passengers

examples.en: The refreshment trolley came past us after the train left the city.
examples.zh: 列车离开市区后，「车上茶点推车」从我们身边经过。

examples.en: My friend asked whether the refreshment trolley sold cups of tea.
examples.zh: 朋友问「车上茶点推车」有没有茶卖。

collocations: buy tea from the refreshment trolley

words.enDefinition: The particular stations where a train is scheduled to stop

examples.en: The screen listed the calling points below the final destination.
examples.zh: 屏幕在终点站下方列出了「沿途停靠站」。

examples.en: I checked the calling points before deciding if I needed to change trains.
examples.zh: 我看了「沿途停靠站」，才决定是否需要换乘。

words.enDefinition: Words introducing stations served by a particular passenger train

examples.en: The announcement said "This train calls at Riverside," so my friend stayed on.
examples.zh: 广播说「本次列车停靠河畔站」，所以我朋友留在车上。

examples.en: The screen showed "This train calls at Central" under the departure time.
examples.zh: 屏幕在发车时间下面写着「本次列车停靠中央站」。

collocations: this train calls at all stations
this train calls at the following stations
this train calls at two stations

words.enDefinition: A notice that a particular service will skip a named station

examples.en: The board showed "Not calling at Riverside" beside our train number.
examples.zh: 显示屏在我们的车次号旁写了「不停靠河畔站」。

examples.en: The conductor said we were "Not calling at Central" this afternoon.
examples.zh: 列车长说，我们这趟下午的列车「不停靠中央站」。

collocations: not calling at the usual stations
not calling at the town centre
a notice saying not calling at

words.zhGloss: 列车将在某站分为两列
words.enDefinition: An announcement that sections of a train will separate at a station
acceptedZhAnswers: 列车将在某站分为两列

examples.en: The conductor said "The train will divide at Central," so I checked my carriage.
examples.zh: 列车长说「列车将在中央站分为两列」，于是我核对了自己的车厢。

examples.en: My friend heard "The train will divide at Riverside" and checked the display.
examples.zh: 朋友听到「列车将在河畔站分为两列」后，看了看显示屏。

collocations: the train will divide at the next station
the train will divide at Riverside
hear that the train will divide at a station

words.enDefinition: The carriages forming the forward section of a passenger train

examples.en: The announcement said the front portion would continue toward the coast.
examples.zh: 广播说，「列车前部」会继续开往海边。

examples.en: I checked whether my seat was in the front portion that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上我核对了座位是否在「列车前部」。

collocations: the front portion of the train

words.enDefinition: The carriages forming the back section of a passenger train

examples.en: The display showed where the rear portion would stop on the platform.
examples.zh: 显示屏标出了「列车后部」会停在站台的哪个位置。

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether we were in the rear portion of the train.
examples.zh: 室友问我们是不是在「列车后部」。

collocations: the rear portion of the train

words.enDefinition: A train made up of fewer carriages than usually run

examples.en: The board warned that the next train was in short formation.
examples.zh: 显示屏提醒，下一趟列车采用「缩短编组」。

examples.en: I heard the announcement about a short formation just before boarding.
examples.zh: 我上车前刚好听到关于「缩短编组」的广播。

collocations: a short formation on this service

words.enDefinition: A system opening only certain train doors at a station

examples.en: The conductor made an announcement about selective door opening before we arrived.
examples.zh: 到站前，列车长广播了「部分车门开启」的情况。

examples.en: I asked which sign explained selective door opening for the next station.
examples.zh: 我问哪块牌子说明下一站「部分车门开启」的安排。

collocations: a train with selective door opening
an announcement about selective door opening

words.enDefinition: An announcement that the service will not carry passengers farther

examples.en: The conductor said, "This train terminates here," just before the doors opened.
examples.zh: 车门打开前，列车长说「本次列车到此终止」。

examples.en: I heard "This train terminates here" and followed my group off the train.
examples.zh: 听到「本次列车到此终止」后，我跟着同行的人下车。

collocations: a notice saying "This train terminates here."

words.enDefinition: A label stating passengers can leave but cannot board at a stop

examples.en: The coach timetable marked our stop "Set down only" on that trip.
examples.zh: 长途大巴时刻表把我们那一站标为「仅供下客」。

examples.en: I asked what "Set down only" meant on the sign behind us.
examples.zh: 我问身后的标牌上「仅供下客」是什么意思。

collocations: a platform listed as set down only

words.enDefinition: A message telling passengers they can enter their train now

examples.en: The screen showed "Train now boarding" while we picked up our bags.
examples.zh: 我们拿起行李时，屏幕显示「列车正在上客」。

examples.en: I heard "Train now boarding" for the express service just past the entrance.
examples.zh: 我刚过入口就听到快车「列车正在上客」的通知。

collocations: a sign saying train now boarding

words.enDefinition: A notice saying a scheduled service will leave later than planned

examples.en: The rail app showed "Departure delayed" just after we reached the station.
examples.zh: 我们刚到车站时，铁路应用显示「发车延误」。

examples.en: I read "Departure delayed" beside our coach on the station display.
examples.zh: 我看到车站屏幕在我们那趟长途大巴旁写着「发车延误」。

collocations: mark a service as departure delayed

words.enDefinition: Words introducing a revised estimate for when a service will arrive

examples.en: The board said "Now expected at six" beside the train number.
examples.zh: 显示屏在车次号旁写着「现预计于六点到站」。

examples.en: I heard "Now expected at nine" and sent my friend a message.
examples.zh: 我听到「现预计于九点到站」，就给朋友发了条消息。

collocations: now expected at the station at noon
mark a train as now expected at seven

words.enDefinition: Words introducing the stated cause of a delay

examples.en: The announcement said we were delayed due to congestion at the station.
examples.zh: 广播说，我们「由于车站拥堵而延误」。

examples.en: The coach message said "Delayed due to traffic" beside our trip details.
examples.zh: 长途大巴消息在行程详情旁写着「由于交通拥堵而延误」。

collocations: delayed due to a signal fault

words.enDefinition: A problem with equipment that controls train movements and spacing

examples.en: The announcement mentioned a signal fault on the route ahead.
examples.zh: 广播提到前方线路有「信号故障」。

examples.en: I read about a signal fault before our train reached the station.
examples.zh: 列车到站之前，我看到了关于「信号故障」的消息。

collocations: a delay caused by a signal fault
a notice about a signal fault

words.enDefinition: Scheduled work on railway infrastructure that may change train services

examples.en: The website showed planned engineering works between two stops on my journey.
examples.zh: 网站上显示，我要经过的两站之间有「计划内铁路施工」。

examples.en: The station put up notices about planned engineering works for the weekend.
examples.zh: 车站张贴了周末「计划内铁路施工」的通知。

collocations: planned engineering works on the line
a notice about planned engineering works
timetable changes for planned engineering works

words.enDefinition: A revised schedule showing changed times or services

examples.en: I checked the amended timetable after the station announced weekend works.
examples.zh: 车站发布周末施工通知后，我查看了「调整后的时刻表」。

examples.en: Our coach appeared later on the amended timetable than we expected.
examples.zh: 「调整后的时刻表」上，我们那趟大巴比预想的晚。

words.enDefinition: A train using a different route from the one originally planned

examples.en: The diverted train still reached our destination but skipped one town.
examples.zh: 「改道运行的列车」仍会到我们的目的地，但跳过一个小镇。

examples.en: My friend asked which route the diverted train would take instead.
examples.zh: 朋友问「改道运行的列车」会改走哪条线路。

words.enDefinition: Cancellation of a travel service with little warning to passengers

examples.en: The short-notice cancellation meant our group had to choose another departure.
examples.zh: 因为「临时通知取消」，我们一行只好选另一个班次。

examples.en: I read about a short-notice cancellation just before leaving for the station.
examples.zh: 出发去车站前，我看到有一趟车「临时通知取消」。

collocations: a short-notice cancellation of a train

words.enDefinition: A different train service available in place of the planned one

examples.en: The website listed an alternative rail service after showing the original train.
examples.zh: 网站先显示原来的列车，然后列出一个「可改乘的铁路班次」。

examples.en: I asked where the alternative rail service would stop along the route.
examples.zh: 我问那个「可改乘的铁路班次」沿途会停在哪里。

collocations: look for an alternative rail service

words.enDefinition: An arrangement recognizing certain tickets on another service or operator

examples.en: I asked which services the ticket acceptance notice referred to.
examples.zh: 我问「其他班次认可原票」的通知指哪些班次。

examples.en: The rail website published an update on ticket acceptance for that day.
examples.zh: 铁路网站发布了当天「其他班次认可原票」的最新消息。

words.zhGloss: 英国铁路晚点补偿制度
words.enDefinition: A British rail scheme concerning compensation for eligible train delays
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国铁路晚点补偿制度

examples.en: The British operator listed Delay Repay on a separate help page.
examples.zh: 英国运营方在单独的帮助页面上列了「英国铁路晚点补偿制度」。

examples.en: I asked what Delay Repay meant in the notice at the station.
examples.zh: 我问车站告示中的「英国铁路晚点补偿制度」指什么。

words.enDefinition: Words announcing that transport begins running again after an interruption

examples.en: The notice said "Service resumes tomorrow" after listing the station names.
examples.zh: 通知列出车站名称后写着「明天服务恢复」。

examples.en: I read "Service resumes later today" on the operator's website.
examples.zh: 我在运营方网站上看到「今天晚些时候服务恢复」。

words.enDefinition: To complete the next part of a journey by long-distance bus

examples.en: The notice said we would continue by coach for the last section.
examples.zh: 告示说，最后一段我们要「改乘大巴继续前往」。

examples.en: I asked which passengers needed to continue by coach after leaving the train.
examples.zh: 我问哪些乘客下火车后需要「改乘大巴继续前往」。

collocations: continue by coach from the station
continue by coach for the final section
be asked to continue by coach

words.enDefinition: An organization responsible for running a train service

examples.en: The train operator sent a message about our new departure time.
examples.zh: 「列车运营方」发了条消息，告知我们新的发车时间。

examples.en: I asked a member of station staff to identify the train operator.
examples.zh: 我请车站工作人员告诉我这趟车的「列车运营方」是谁。

collocations: a message from the train operator

words.enDefinition: A short identifier representing a railway station in timetable systems

examples.en: I checked the station code so I could find the right station.
examples.zh: 我核对了「车站代码」，以便找到正确的车站。

examples.en: The booking listed the station code beside the full station name.
examples.zh: 订单在车站全名旁边列出了「车站代码」。

words.enDefinition: A small display indicating whether and when a seat is reserved

examples.en: I looked at the seat reservation display before sitting by the window.
examples.zh: 在靠窗坐下前，我看了看「座位预订显示屏」。

examples.en: My friend checked which stations appeared on the seat reservation display above us.
examples.zh: 朋友核对了头顶「座位预订显示屏」上显示的是哪几站。

collocations: a seat reservation display above each seat

words.enDefinition: A letter identifying one passenger carriage of a particular train

examples.en: I matched the carriage letter by the door to the one on my ticket.
examples.zh: 我把车门旁的「车厢字母编号」和车票上的编号核对了一下。

examples.en: The carriage letter was painted just below the first window.
examples.zh: 「车厢字母编号」涂在第一扇窗户正下方。

collocations: match the carriage letter to your ticket

words.enDefinition: A station serving an important route in a railway network

examples.en: We walked from the mainline station to the university after our train ride.
examples.zh: 下火车后，我们从「干线铁路车站」走到大学。

examples.en: My friend told me which mainline station served the city centre.
examples.zh: 朋友告诉我哪座「干线铁路车站」通往市中心。

words.enDefinition: A bicycle designed to fold into a more compact shape

examples.en: I asked whether my folding bicycle would fit beside the luggage rack.
examples.zh: 我问我的「折叠自行车」能不能放在行李架旁边。

examples.en: My friend brought a folding bicycle on the regional train to campus.
examples.zh: 朋友带着一辆「折叠自行车」坐区域列车去了学校。

collocations: carry a folding bicycle on a train

words.enDefinition: An announcement that a train will continue in the opposite direction

examples.en: The conductor said "The train will reverse direction" as we pulled into the station.
examples.zh: 列车进站时，列车长说「列车将换向行驶」。

examples.en: I heard "The train will reverse direction" and checked the route on my phone.
examples.zh: 我听到「列车将换向行驶」后，用手机核对了线路。

collocations: a notice saying "The train will reverse direction."

words.enDefinition: Words addressing travelers headed to a certain destination

examples.en: The announcement began "Passengers for Riverside" before naming another platform.
examples.zh: 广播先说「前往河畔站的乘客」，然后报了另一个站台。

examples.en: I heard "Passengers for Central" and listened for the platform number.
examples.zh: 听到「前往中央站的乘客」后，我接着听广播报哪个站台。

words.enDefinition: A sloping surface allowing passengers to move between platform and vehicle

examples.en: A staff member brought a boarding ramp to the train door.
examples.zh: 工作人员把一块「登车坡板」拿到了列车门边。

examples.en: I asked who would meet us with the boarding ramp at Central.
examples.zh: 我问到中央站时谁会带着「登车坡板」来接我们。

words.enDefinition: A call telling passengers to enter a train before it leaves

examples.en: The conductor called "All aboard!" just before we stepped onto the train.
examples.zh: 我们上车前，列车长喊了声「请各位上车！」

examples.en: I heard "All aboard!" while standing near the front of the train.
examples.zh: 我站在靠近车头的位置时，听到有人喊「请各位上车！」

words.enDefinition: A station between the start and end of a railway service

examples.en: My roommate boarded at an intermediate station after my train left Central.
examples.zh: 我的列车离开中央站后，室友在一处「中途停靠站」上了车。

examples.en: The conductor announced the last intermediate station before our destination.
examples.zh: 列车长报了终点之前最后一个「中途停靠站」。

collocations: an intermediate station on the route

words.enDefinition: Baggage kept in a coach's lower compartment during the journey

examples.en: The coach driver told us where to collect our hold luggage.
examples.zh: 长途大巴司机告诉我们去哪里取「行李舱内行李」。

examples.en: I asked where the label for my hold luggage should go.
examples.zh: 我问「行李舱内行李」的标签应该贴在哪儿。
